tool: Meshy text-to-3D API (POST /openapi/v2/text-to-3d, preview then refine), then Blender 5.2.3 LTS headless (scripts/blender/street_props.py): join, weld UV seams, drop floating parts, recalc normals, smooth by angle 30 deg, scale to meters, origin at bottom center, +z forward / +y up, Draco GLB export
pipeline: node scripts/assets/meshy-street-props.mjs (needs MESHY_API_KEY in env; raw downloads go to .meshy-raw/, git-ignored)
license: Generated with the project owner's Meshy account; usage is governed by Meshy's terms of service for that account.
format: GLB, POSITION + NORMAL + TEXCOORD_0, PBR material with 3 JPEG textures, KHR_draco_mesh_compression (needs a DRACOLoader, as in src/render/skater-model.js). sedan, pickup, bus, hatchback, van, taxi, box_truck: body plus 4 wheel meshes and the wheels_roll clip
style: Realistic mid-2010s Atlanta street, no branding (prompts forbid logos and text)
verify: node scripts/assets/street-props-check.mjs --out preview.png <glb...> loads the files in headless Chromium with GLTFLoader + DRACOLoader
asset: Street traffic vehicles for Skate ATL: sedan, bus, pickup, hatchback, van, taxi (fictional livery: yellow with a teal checker band, blank roof sign), box truck (plain white, no brand). Lengths match CAR_SIZE in src/sim/traffic/traffic.js where it has the kind; taxi 4.9 m and box truck 7.5 m are new kinds.

vehicles_lod.glb.tool: Blender 5.2.3 LTS headless, no generative tool (0 Meshy credits)
vehicles_lod.glb.script: blender -b -P scripts/blender/vehicle_lods.py -- (reads the 7 rigged LOD0 GLBs in this folder)
vehicles_lod.glb.source: Derived from sedan.glb, pickup.glb, bus.glb, hatchback.glb, van.glb, taxi.glb, box_truck.glb (the Meshy models above, same license).
vehicles_lod.glb.contents: Per kind <kind>_lod1_* (collapse decimate to ~35% of LOD0 triangles; body > steer_FL/FR > wheel_FL/FR, body > wheel_RL/RR with the LOD0 pivots) and <kind>_lod2 (~10%, body and wheels merged into one mesh). All on one material vehicle_atlas: 2048x1024 JPEG base color, metallic-roughness and normal atlases (512x512 per kind, 1024x512 for the bus, 8 texel padding). Draco, no animation (src/render/car-models.js spins and steers the wheels itself).
